about: Maps outside-assessment topic names (ATI, HESI, Kaplan, UWorld and others, named descriptively) to Vexcura's NCLEX client-need categories and finer subtopics. kw = keyword stems for fuzzy matching and for picking bank questions; tp = daily/topics.json topic ids; g = /study-guides/<slug>; ehr = practice activity id for clinical topics. Built by scratchpad scores-build/build-topicmap.js. Vendor-specific names need verification against real reports.
